summary_en: This paper proposes amplitude-based CUTE (a-CUTE), an echo-mode speed-of-sound tomography method that retains and inverts angle-dependent echo-amplitude information instead of reducing each echo to a differential time-of-flight measurement. The recovered sub-beamwidth aberration profiles improve spatial resolution and suppress artifacts caused by the beamwidth-angular-aperture trade-off. Simulations, physical phantoms, and preliminary in-vivo data support feasibility. It is a direct acoustic image-formation contribution, but should remain in the candidate collection until peer-reviewed publication metadata is available.

summary_en: This work realizes three-dimensional underwater acoustic holography with a binary metasurface optimized by a genetic algorithm. A spatially discretized volumetric target is incorporated into an angular-spectrum forward model, and global optimization determines a binary structure that reconstructs the target through the measured sound-intensity distribution. Experimental validation makes it a direct and strong core addition for acoustic holography and computational wavefront shaping.

summary_en: ASP-NET combines acoustic spatial patterns with a convolutional neural network to reconstruct structural vibration and radiated sound fields from noise-contaminated hologram measurements. The spatial-pattern coefficients provide a compressed, physically interpretable output representation, while an energy-constrained simulation method reduces the amount of training data required. Numerical experiments report robust single-layer-array reconstruction at negative SNR and substantially lower error than truncated-SVD NAH, making this a direct core acoustic-imaging addition.
